title: Quiz: Scientific Edge Cases & Anomalies Quiz

quiz.question: Is pure liquid water at $25^\circ\text{C}$ considered an amphoteric substance under Brønsted-Lowry theory?

answerOptions.text: True — it can act as both an acid and a base.
answerOptions.rationale: Water can donate a proton to form $OH^{-}$ or accept a proton to form $H_{3}O^{+}$.

answerOptions.text: False — it acts exclusively as a neutral solvent.

quiz.question: Which transition metal ion exhibits a $d^{10}$ closed-shell configuration in its +2 oxidation state?
quiz.hint: Found in group 12 of the periodic table.

answerOptions.rationale: Zinc loses its two $4s$ electrons upon ionization, leaving a completely filled $[Ar]3d^{10}$ configuration.
